_note: Legal and regulatory numbers used by the engine, kept as data. 'status' is verified (read in the primary source on the date shown), secondary (read in an agency notice that quotes the regulation), or assumption (a modelling choice, not law). Not legal advice.

params.label: Base deadline for acute care inpatient hospital buildings
params.note: Owner must demolish, replace, change to nonacute use, or retrofit buildings not in substantial compliance. Section last amended by Stats. 2024, ch. 896 (SB 1447).

params.label: Latest compliance date under a § 130065.1(b) delay (up to three years)
params.note: Added by AB 869 (Stats. 2024, ch. 801); section amended by Stats. 2025, ch. 67 (AB 1170).

params.label: Outer limit with the discretionary additional two-year delay
params.note: HCAI PIN 80 says the additional delay will not be considered before January 1, 2030.

params.label: Fine per calendar day for missing the revised schedule or a major milestone
params.citation: Health & Saf. Code § 130065.1(g); HCAI PIN 80 p. 10
params.note: PIN 80 applies the fine per facility and only to critical milestones. The statute does not say whether overlapping misses stack.
